## Checklist

- [ ] `claude plugin validate --strict .` passes
- [ ] Version bumped in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` if plugin behavior changed (skill, hook, script, or template). Not required for docs-only changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under a version heading if behavior changed
- [ ] README or the guide updated if the change is user-facing
- [ ] No em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, ellipsis characters, non-breaking spaces, or unicode minus in any changed file or in commit messages
- [ ] Commits use conventional commit format
